_comment: Videowall Creator part catalogue. Edited here, not in the JS - the tool fetches this from jsDelivr at runtime, so a part number change needs NO code release, tag or loader re-pin. Mirrors the data/stage-designer/ pattern. Any key omitted falls back to the inline default baked into videowall-creator.js.

bar1.label: Uniview UR Pro Rigging Bar 1m on Sling

bar05.label: Uniview UR Pro Rigging Bar 0.5m on Sling

bar1.label: Chauvet REM 1m Header Bar on Clamp

bar05.label: Chauvet REM 0.5m Curve Header Bar on Clamp

bar1.label: Chauvet REM 1m Header Bar on Sling

bar05.label: Chauvet REM 0.5m Curve Header Bar on Sling

kit.label: Uniview UR Pro Ground Support Kit (2 uprights)

_ballastPlateNote: 12.5kg plate used by BOTH ground systems. plateKg drives the round-up, so changing it here changes the plate count.
_procCablesNote: Inter-processor link cables. Added at (processorCount - 1) sets each - one link between every pair of adjacent boxes.
_cablesNote: Starter cables, one per line. Doubled when backup is running (primary + backup, Adam 2026-08-27). REM: banded Ethercon stock (5/10/20m, pick smallest that fits width+rowHeight). Uniview: fixed 15m starter. A REM line requiring MORE than the longest stock uses max + Ethercon Joiner + smallest extension (Adam 2026-08-28). One spare added per unique stock length used per wall.
_powerNote: Power distribution. 1 x 16A circuit carries up to 9 panels (REM and Uniview, same rule - Adam 2026-10-04). <=8 panels total: 13A direct, no distro, TRUE1 adaptor auto-pulled by HireHop. 1 x 16A direct: 9 panels, TRUE1 adaptor auto. Multi-circuit floor: regular 16A-outlet distros up to 8 circuits, then socapex. Multi-circuit flown: regular distros up to 3 circuits, then socapex top-down. Each distro gets a 16A->4-way for processor power. Supplies that are too small warn with a suggested right-size (not a hard block). All cable stock lengths listed; feed length to source assumed 20-40m by default. 125A 3ph not yet spec'd. panelsPer16A, maxPanels13A, maxCircuitsFloorNoSoca, maxCircuitsFlownNoSoca are catalogue-editable.

true1Adaptor.label: 13A to TRUE1 Adaptor (HireHop auto-pulls 1 per 10 panels)

_rearScaffNote: Ground-supported walls only, both REM and Uniview (Adam, 2026-09-06). Horizontal scaff runs link the uprights (standards) together at the back for stability. LEVELS: first run at firstLevelAboveFloorM (1.5m), then every levelSpacingM (1.5m) up to wall height. TUBE CHOICE per level: smallest stock STRICTLY GREATER than the span it must cover - standards are 1m apart on REM (or as close as 0.5m on some Uniview widths) and a tube equal to the span lands exactly on the outer standards, leaving no bite for the clamps. Greedy chain: pick the longest single tube that fits from the current start standard, then start the next tube at the last standard the previous tube covered (tubes overlap at that shared standard). CLAMPS: 1 per tube-to-standard crossing. LEG (YW-00013) is NOT a ledger tube - it is a vertical scaff leg, listed here for catalogue completeness.
